Daily Devotional

September 1

20 But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal: 21 For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also. (Matthew 6:20-21 KJV)

We cannot take our treasures to heaven with us when we die, but we can do things on earth to send it on ahead of us to heaven. Jesus says that giving to the poor will lay up treasures in heaven for us (Matthew 19:21, Luke 12:33). Also we can use our money to help people hear and understand the Gospel, and they will welcome us into heaven when we arrive there (Luke 16:9).

Verse 21 is so true, as where you spend and invest your money and other treasures, is where your heart will be also. If you spend and think only on worldly matters all the time, then you will be totally carnal, and will tend to stray from God and His ways (1 Timothy 6:10). Money and things tend to draw us away from the Lord (Mark 4:19). Money itself is not evil and can be used mightily for the good of God’s kingdom here on earth, but the love of money is one of the primary sins that man falls into, and can destroy the faith of a Christian. Jesus said that it is hard for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God (Matthew 19:23-24), because so many rich people trust in their riches instead of trusting the Lord. You must keep your faith in God, as that is what pleases Him (Hebrews 11:6). We must obey Jesus to assure our eternal salvation (Hebrews 5:9). Praise God!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
